# Fetch and inspect candidate flight confirmation email threads for baggage weight limit
pw = [x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='gmail'][0]['password']
username='lindseysimpson@gmail.com'
gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username=username, password=pw)['access_token']

candidate_ids = [47821, 47823, 47825]
for tid in candidate_ids:
    thread = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gmail_token)
    # collect bodies
    bodies = [email['body'] for email in thread.get('emails', [])]
    all_text = '\n'.join(bodies)
    # simple extract of lines containing baggage or kg
    lines = [ln.strip() for ln in all_text.split('\n') if ('kg' in ln.lower() or 'baggage' in ln.lower() or 'check-in' in ln.lower())]
    print('thread', tid, 'subject', thread.get('emails',[{}])[0].get('subject',''))
    print('num_lines', len(lines))
    print('\n'.join(lines[:20]))
    print('---')
